offering_description.value: Runs online auctions and yards that sell damaged, repossessed and end-of-life vehicles, mostly consigned by insurers, to dealers, rebuilders, exporters and other vehicle buyers. It earns fees from sellers and buyers and handles vehicle storage and title work.

primary_products.value: salvage vehicles; total-loss vehicles; used vehicles

primary_services.value: online vehicle auctions; vehicle storage and yard services; title processing; vehicle transport

customer_segment.value: B2B: insurance companies, rental fleets, dealers, rebuilders, vehicle exporters

end_markets.value: automotive; insurance; vehicle remarketing; used vehicle trade

revenue_model.value: service fees: seller and buyer fees on vehicle auction sales; service fees: yard storage, title and transport fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sells vehicles on behalf of insurers and other sellers for a fee, to dealers and rebuilders; software / platform: online auction platform connecting sellers and buyers; asset operator: owns and operates vehicle yards and facilities where vehicles are stored and processed
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, UK, Brazil, Germany, Spain, United Arab Emirates and other countries

specialization.value: niche specialist: single line: salvage and total-loss vehicle auctions

distribution_channels.value: online: online auctions open to registered buyers; own locations: company-operated vehicle yards and auction sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: medium: vehicle title, salvage and auto auction rules, environmental rules for vehicle handling, and data privacy
